anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
The ticket repair is saved and verified. acme/widgets#77 now has one acceptance criterion: "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." I'm treating that row as in-scope. It matches the path I traced, where `settings/resolver.ts:12` owns the defaults and `ui/report-view.ts:30` consumes the resolved settings. The new setting will be a key under that resolver, with no view-local settings object.

One behavior decision is still open. What should happen to active report filters when the user switches workspaces?

A) Reset filters on a workspace change by default. The setting lets users opt out and keep their filters across workspaces.
B) Keep filters by default, as today. The setting lets users opt in to resetting them on a workspace change.
C) On a workspace change, drop only filters whose values don't exist in the new workspace. The setting turns this pruning on or off.
D) Other - name it.

Recommendation: A - the reported harm is filters hiding rows in the new workspace, and resetting by default fixes that for everyone while still letting users keep filters when they want to.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
The repair is saved and verified: acme/widgets#77 now requires the shared settings resolver. We’ll keep that ownership, with defaults in `settings/resolver.ts:12` and resolved settings consumed by `ui/report-view.ts:30`.

What should happen to active report filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear them — show the new workspace without filters carried over.
B) Restore the destination workspace’s previous filters — remember filters separately per workspace.
C) Keep them — preserve the current cross-workspace behavior.
D) Other — name it.
Recommendation: A - it directly prevents carried-over filters from hiding rows without introducing per-workspace filter storage.
